name: Mixed Temptation Matina
description: Authentic Chinese dishes including egg, pork spareribs with salt and pepper, and their signature Peking duck. Immaculate cleanliness and welcoming atmosphere.

name: Benjarong Bar and Restaurant Davao
description: Exceptional flavors, especially the Massaman curry. The staff and crew assisted us very well.

name: Madayaw Cafe
description: Perfect Place for Bonding with the Fam and the adobo rice bowl—both absolutely delicious!

name: Luk Foo Palace At Acacia Hotel Davao
description: Peking duck was an absolute delight, as well as the fried rice

name: Siam Lounge
description: I really love the Afternoon High Tea at Siam Lounge.

name: Waling Waling Cafe At Acacia Hotel Davao
description: Mom’s Memorable Birthday at Acacia Hotel Davao – Waling Waling Cafe!

name: Vikings Luxury Buffet
description: Vikings has a lot of food to choose from -- appetizers to desserts.

name: Mixed Temptation Restaurant Airport
description: Right now, I am craving dumplings again! Recommended!

name: Jack's Ridge
description: In my first visit to Davao we loved made an early Valentine's day night here.

name: Lachi's
description: We were brought here on the recommendation of our driver during our last day of the trip.

name: Yellow Fin Seafood Restaurant
description: Everything was cooked perfectly and the tuna and other fish were incredibly fresh.

name: Blue Post Boiling Crabs and Shrimps
description: Foods were delicious but a bit pricey for its serving.

name: The Vegan Dinosaur
description: Well worth visiting here, the food is great, and it's a lovely restaurant.
